quarterly_data.signal: NRG's Q2 2026 earnings release: on May 26, 2026 NRG achieved commercial operations at its first Texas Energy Fund (TEF) project, the 415 MW T.H. Wharton facility, its first new build generation asset in nearly a decade, and on June 17, 2026 entered into a completion bonus grant agreement with the PUCT for T.H. Wharton for up to $54.72 million, paid in ten annual installments subject to facility performance after the initial test period ends on May 31, 2027. The two additional TEF projects remain on time and on budget, and NRG plans to bring the program's new generation online by mid-2028. The release describes NRG as operating approximately 25 GW of power generation.
quarterly_data.figure: T.H. Wharton 415 MW in commercial operation (May 26, 2026); PUCT completion bonus grant up to $54.72 million; TEF program generation online by mid-2028; approximately 25 GW of generation operated

quarterly_data.signal: NRG reaffirmed its 2026 guidance ranges, which are company-wide (NRG's segments include Vivint Smart Home alongside Texas, East and West/Other) and include 11 months of ownership of the portfolio acquired from LS Power: Adjusted EBITDA $5,325 - $5,825 million, Free Cash Flow before Growth Investments $2,800 - $3,300 million, Adjusted Net Income $1,685 - $2,115 million and Adjusted EPS $7.90 - $9.90.
